dedupe_keys.name: inter urban cellular mobility in the southeast songliao basin

description: The Songliao mobility research team publishes inter-urban movements derived from cellular position tracking in Northeast China. Its Figshare collection has two components: a weekly mobility network and geographic positions for the network nodes. Both are distributed as text files and both state CC BY 4.0, permitting free access and reuse with attribution. Collection version 4 was released in April 2019. Spatial coverage is the southeast Songliao Basin; the inspected repository summaries do not state the complete observation dates or an exact time step within the weekly network. The location table supports geographic interpretation of the network, but cellular positions should not be treated as individual road trajectories or exact origins. These data can inform movement between urban areas, regional demand allocation and exposure scenarios in network or agent-based simulations. They complement data-telecom-italia-big-data-challenge with a different region and mobility product. The selected operator population and aggregation choices need checking before inferring total travel volumes or transferring the network to another period.
